_comment: LEVEL 3 (feature): billing vertical slice — plans, subscribe/cancel, invoices. Money in integer cents, provider-agnostic (record_invoice is idempotent for gateway webhooks). Pairs with feature-auth (get_current_user) and feature-webhook.
name: feature-billing
description: Subscription billing: plan catalog + subscribe/cancel + idempotent invoice recording. Provider-agnostic — wire Stripe/Paddle via record_invoice from webhooks.

variables.name: app_name
variables.description: Python package name, e.g. 'app' or 'demo_api' (drives all nested imports)

variables.name: currency
variables.description: Default ISO currency code for new money columns

notes: After applying: 1) app.include_router(router) in main.py and import models.billing so tables are created, 2) requires the users table from feature-auth (ForeignKey users.id), 3) set a payment gateway: call billing_service.record_invoice from its webhook (pair with feature-webhook), 4) protect create_plan with require_role('admin') from feature-rbac, 5) money is integer cents everywhere — never floats.
